title: Pilot cohort launch orchestration checklist and cross-team playbook
creator: Ava Chen
description: Master playbook for orchestrating a focused pilot cohort (10-15 lighthouse accounts) for the Redwood API feature set: private model routing, KV cache opt-in, and streaming improvements. Covers selection criteria for lighthouse accounts, a coordinated release-notes and communications plan, feedback loops, success metrics, and per-team action items to reach a GA gating decision.
objectives: Validate production latency and cost targets on Dedicated and Private deployments with real customer traffic patterns
Collect qualitative and quantitative feedback from lighthouse accounts to refine default autoscaling and batching configs
Ship coordinated release notes and SDK/CLI updates so customers can adopt without support friction
Define clear GA gating criteria and escalation paths for rollout decisions
lighthouse_selection_criteria: Must have a production-ish workload that generates >=1k inference requests/day or sustained burst patterns
Willingness to run instrumentation (OpenTelemetry spans + token-level cost logs) and sign an NDA/pilot agreement
Coverage across verticals: two consumer apps, two SaaS platforms, one regulated (finance/health), one platform infra team
Geographic diversity: NA, EU, APAC (at least one non-NA account)
feedback_collection_plan: Primary channels: weekly feedback syncs (30m) + structured feedback form (link to Drive) + SDK error telemetry. Engineering will expose a lightweight feedback endpoint + tag 'pilot-7081' on all relevant traces. PM will synthesize a weekly digest with top 5 regressions and recommended fixes. Support tickets from pilots get VIP triage with 4h SLA during pilot hours.
release_notes_coordination: Draft release notes in shared doc (Drive link) that include: key changes, migration steps, known issues, configuration knobs
Docs/SDK owners must publish migration examples and code snippets 5 business days before pilot start
Marketing to approve customer-facing language; legal to approve any claims for SLA or compliance
Maintain a single changelog PR in docs repo and link to SDK PRs and runtime changelog
Assign a single release-notes owner (PM) to cut and publish the pilot release note and track translations
roles_and_owners: PM (Diego Morales): overall pilot lead, host weekly syncs, synthesize feedback, publish pilot release note
Eng Lead (Priya Rao): scoped runtime changes, rollout gates, engage on critical bug triage
SRE (Liam Patel): observability dashboard, SLOs, incident runbook
Developer Experience (Sofia Nguyen): SDK rollout, migration guides, code samples
Design (Marco Alvarez): small UX copy updates for Console and onboarding flows
Support (Nina Kaplan): VIP triage, pilot support channel
Legal/Compliance (Rachel Stein): review pilot agreements and data flow for regulated customers
Marketing (Ethan Brooks): pilot announcement and coordinated comms for lighthouse participants
pre_launch_checklist: Confirm pilot contracts and NDAs signed by all lighthouse accounts
Enable pilot feature flags in orgs and verify RBAC access
Deploy runtime-1.20 to a dedicated pilot fleet and smoke test with synthetic workload
Create per-account dashboards in Console: latency P50/P95, per-token cost, error rate
Prepare rollback plan: compatible model variant + immediate fallback region
Publish migration guide and SDK patches to npm/PyPI with beta tags
Confirm alerting thresholds and on-call rotations for pilot hours
Schedule weekly pilot review calendar invite with all stakeholders
launch_day_runbook: Morning: quick health-checks by SRE and Eng (30m), confirm telemetry flows. Midday: first 3 lighthouse accounts traffic ramp to 10% of target. PM to gather first impressions and surface any critical support tickets. Afternoon: run synthesis session to prioritize fixes. Evening: decide whether to continue ramp or pause based on GA gating checks.
ga_gating_criteria: Reliability: sustained error rate <= 0.5% over 72h across pilot fleet
Latency: P95 latency within 1.5x of pre-pilot benchmark for >=90% of requests
Cost: key customers show expected cost-per-1k tokens within tolerance +/-20%
Support: no unresolved P0/P1 issues older than 4 business hours
Feedback: qualitative NPS-style indicator average >= 7/10 and no major UX blockers
post_launch_actions: 72h synthesis doc with telemetry and top action items
Customer interviews scheduled within 10 business days to capture qualitative input
Open engineering backlog items created with priority tags and estimated points
Decision memo for GA (Approve / Require changes / Rollback) with signatures from PM, Eng Lead, SRE, and Security
Internal retrospective within 14 days to capture lessons and update this playbook
risks_and_mitigations: Uninstrumented customer telemetry: require SDK opt-in and provide step-by-step setup; fallback to synthetic workloads
Regression in quantized kernels: can roll back to float variant or previous kernel selection during fallback window
Data residency concerns for regulated pilots: offer Private deployment option and on-prem checklist
Surge traffic causing queueing: pre-configure burst capacity and throttling policy per org
dependencies: ENG-8450 (pilot telemetry tagging and storage retention)
acceptance_criteria: Pilot run has at least 8 lighthouse accounts active for >=7 days
Weekly pilot digest published and shared with stakeholders each Friday
GA decision memo completed with explicit next steps
All release notes and SDK migrations live and referenced by pilot customers
notes: This playbook is intentionally prescriptive for a small, high-touch pilot. If we scale to >30 accounts we should switch to a cohort model with automated onboarding and lower-touch support. Update this doc after the first pilot retrospective.
